history.summary: A 463sqft freehold shoebox 1BR in the 58-unit boutique Singa Hills, asking $1,901 psf — a ~7% premium to the $1,781 URA median. Appreciation looks decent at ~6%/yr but on only 20 transactions in a thinly-traded 58-unit development, and the 920m walk to Kaki Bukit limits the rental edge.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and a low $880k absolute entry are attractive, but a 463sqft shoebox in a 58-unit boutique is a thin-liquidity, niche product: only 20 URA txn, 32 draws in the arena (low decisiveness), and a +7% PSF premium to median. The ~6%/yr rate is plausible but not high-confidence on 20 txn. Tranquil location is a plus for tenants but 920m from the MRT caps the yield premium. Lands as a measured Neutral.
red_flags: Only 20 URA txn — rate moderately reliable
catalysts: Low $880k absolute price — broad shoebox-investor pool
